acceptance_rule: A component is runtime-tested only after an exact source revision, guest-visible contract, and applicable differential evidence are recorded.

components.name: cpu-topology-and-system-state
components.guest_visible_purpose: AArch64 exception levels, system registers, translation, atomics, SMP, timer, and PAuth state
components.known_gap: The shipped translator is a bounded user-mode subset; the requested feature bits are rejected before JIT entry.

components.name: memory-map-and-reset
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1-specific reset vector, RAM map, reserved ranges, and reset ordering
components.venfire_destination: not started; Phase-2 fixed diagnostic RAM is not an M1 map
components.known_gap: No exact M1 guest memory map/reset trace is pinned.

components.name: apple-interrupt-controller
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1 interrupt routing, masking, acknowledgement, affinity, and reset state
components.venfire_destination: sandbox/devices/aic_v1.c (standalone reference model; not wired into an M1 graph)
components.known_gap: The AIC v1 self-test is not proof of M1 register identity or guest device-tree wiring. GIC is forbidden as a fallback.

components.name: timer-and-counter
components.guest_visible_purpose: Architectural timer/counter frequency, interrupts, and reset behavior

source.project: Arm A-profile architecture plus M1 firmware traces

components.known_gap: No M1 timer frequency, interrupt routing, or boot-time trace is available.

components.name: firmware-identity-and-handoff
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1-only firmware identity, device-tree/firmware handoff, and boot contract

source.project: Apple virtual-Mac or physical M1 boot contract

components.known_gap: An OpenCore iBoot pointer handoff is diagnostic metadata only and is not this contract.

components.name: serial-and-diagnostic-channel
components.venfire_destination: EFI console trace only; no M1 UART device
components.known_gap: EFI debug output must not be relabeled as an Apple guest UART.

components.name: storage-controller-and-provisioning
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1 storage namespace, controller, provisioning, and error semantics

source.project: Apple ANS/NVMe or VMApple storage contract

components.known_gap: No target-matched storage image/controller contract is supplied to the EFI package.

components.name: dma-and-iommu
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1 DMA addressability, isolation, faulting, and invalidation
components.known_gap: The repository's x86 VSK DMAR validators are not an M1 DART implementation.

components.name: recovery-transport
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1 recovery/reset transport and signed recovery input boundary
components.known_gap: The separate VMApple research transport is not part of this EFI runtime and has no M1 native evidence here.

components.name: display-path
components.guest_visible_purpose: M1 framebuffer/display discovery, allocation, and presentation
components.known_gap: No framebuffer or display device is exposed by the diagnostic machine.

components.name: iboot-xnu-macos-boot-chain
components.guest_visible_purpose: Immutable firmware input, iBoot-to-XNU handoff, runtime, installer, and reboot evidence

source.project: Apple signed firmware and recovery inputs

components.venfire_destination: not started; Phase-1 explicitly does not open iBoot input
components.known_gap: No Apple trust root, signed input set, target-matched storage, or M1 runtime is present. All boot-success fields remain false.
